Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data synthesis and entity resolution. In Step 4, the Planner incorrectly assumed that "A Question of Attribution" was directed by Mike Leigh (born 1943) based on a "Preliminary expectation" rather than the actual search results. The WebSurfer's search in Step 3 explicitly returned results identifying the director as John Schlesinger (born 1926) for the 1991 TV film adaptation, which is the only film version of the title found. Despite this clear evidence, the Planner failed to update its understanding, ignored the correct director (Schlesinger), and proceeded with the wrong director (Leigh) to make a false comparison. This led to the incorrect final conclusion that *I Come with the Rain* had the earlier-born director, when in reality, John Schlesinger (1926) was born significantly earlier than Tran Anh Hung (1962).
